newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain confident of joining EMU from start - Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Spain confident of joining EMU from start - Folgado.

text.p: Spain's deficit secretary Jose Folgado on Tuesday said the government was confident that Spain would be among the first members of a European economic and monetary union (EMU).
"We think that Spain will be in the first nucleus of countries to join in EMU from January 1 1999," Folgado told the Association for Management Development.
Folgado said current budget progress would allow Spain to reduce its budget deficit to its target of 4.4 percent of gross domestic poroduct (GDP) in 1996.
The budget adjustment for 1997 laid the foundations for reducing the deficit to the three percent of GDP required by the Maastricht treaty to join a single European currency.
But he warned that the four percent wage growth demanded by unions would be incompatible with the convergence programme. Wage moderation was necessary, Folgado said.
